rule: At least one source records this binomial as an accepted name while at least one other records it as a synonym of a different name. Compared field: `relation` (accepted vs synonym_of).
Every source agrees this binomial is a synonym, but they name different accepted parents for it. Compared field: `accepted_name` on the synonym rows.
Every source agrees this binomial is a synonym of one and the same parent, but that parent is itself contested, so the placement cannot be resolved. No field disagrees on this name directly.
